cards.mechanism: When the trailing 7-bar (4H) true-range sum compresses into its lowest quintile of the trailing 120 bars, the next directional range expansion is more likely to persist, because compressed ranges reflect balanced positioning that resolves into one-sided flow.
cards.measurable_observable: Forward 10-bar (4H) return following compression-breakout entries vs the null comparator, net of 25 bps.
cards.bar_definition: 4H bars, America/New_York, 09:30 anchor; decision at bar close; fill at next bar open.
cards.entry_exit_rules: Entry: completed 4H bar closes above the high of the prior 7-bar compressed range AND the 7-bar range sum is in its lowest trailing-120-bar quintile. Exit: frozen system exit stack (structural stop, TP1, 30-bar cap).
cards.null_control_comparator: Identical breakout entries WITHOUT the compression condition, same universe and window.
cards.preregistered_falsification_test: If compression-conditioned entries do not beat the unconditioned breakout null by at least +0.10R expectancy at 25 bps on the preregistered window, the hypothesis is falsified.
